crossRefs.note: Then I brought up the princes of Judah on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in…
and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

translations.web: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;
translations.bsb: The two thanksgiving choirs then stood in the house of God, as did I, along with the half of the officials accompanying me,
translations.kjv: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers
translations.asv: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;
